 Who We Are
 Leadership
 Ryan Puckett 
 CEO & Founder 
 Originally from Oklahoma, Ryan relocated to Chicago in his early 20s to kickstart his career as a Data Center Engineer. With over 15 years of experience, he has developed deep expertise in Data Center Operations, having worked for industry giants including Microsoft, JPMC, New Relic, and Salesforce—including high-frequency trading environments where precision and speed are paramount.
Ryan's passion for technology was sparked at a young age, inspired by his entrepreneurial grandfather who founded a remote hands provider specializing in nationwide printer repair in the 1990s. This early influence drove Ryan to pursue a path where innovation and entrepreneurship intersect.
2025 EY Entrepreneur of the Year Finalist, Midwest. 
 AJ Cruz 
 VP of Technical Operations 
 Nearly twenty years servicing and optimizing high-availability data centers. Recognized for streamlining processes, reducing downtime, and building teams that deliver. 
 John Vasel 
 Director of Technical Operations 
 19+ years in data center operations and project management. Director roles at Align and Pinebreeze. Expert in professional services, asset management, and multi-project execution. 
 Frida Matta 
 Human Resources Manager 
 Dedicated to building strong, trust-based relationships. Champions Introl's culture of inclusivity and accountability. Led initiatives improving employee satisfaction and retention.
